conviction_note: abs_move 8.0 (the ADR's own last four confirmed prints moved roughly +10 to +18, +11, +1 to +2.5 and -8 to -12.6 in Stockholm; option-implied 8.63 on a chain with an 18% ATM spread agrees) times a p_up of 55: the one company-level primary-document number (SEK 5bn of finished-goods inventory built in Q2 for planned Q3 deliveries, CFO on the Q2 call) points to Networks sales above the +6% q/q consensus, while the line the stock last sold off on (gross margin and the next-quarter margin guide under component-cost inflation) is the live negative and is only partly in the bar; the findings sum (+0.9) and the scaled number (+0.8) agree in sign and size.
bar: Infront consensus compiled 2026-10-08 (16 analysts): net sales SEK 55.4bn, Networks SEK 35.1bn, CSS SEK 15.2bn, Enterprise SEK 4.7bn, adjusted gross margin 47.3%, adjusted EBITA SEK 7.9bn (14.2%) via https://hurbra.se/ericsson-rapport-q3-2026-infor/ (2026-10-12); agrees with the Infront sheet of 2026-07-27 (15 analysts, net sales SEK 55.5bn, EBITA 7.9bn) at https://www.ericsson.com/4a1f6a/assets/local/investors/documents/shareholder-information/analyst-consensus/eric-post-26q2-web-consensus---infront.pdf and with the company's own data-points page (Networks consensus +6% q/q against +1% seasonality; company guide Networks adj GM 48-50%) at https://www.ericsson.com/en/investors/financial-reports-and-presentations/current-quarter-data-points (2026-09-11). Q2 2026 base: Networks SEK 33.0bn, group adj GM 48.4%, adj EBITA SEK 6.9bn. Q3 2025 comparatives (company report 2025-10-14): net sales 56.2bn, Networks 35.4bn, Networks adj GM 50.1%, group adj GM 48.1%, IPR 3.1bn, adj EBITA 15.8bn including a 7.6bn iconectiv gain (about 8.2bn ex-gain).
positioning_check: ADR line: 74.8M ADS short at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, +16.0% from 64.5M at 2026-09-15, days to cover 10.2 (was 3.7 at 2026-07-15), percent of float not given (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/eric/short-interest/). Stockholm: Finansinspektionen aggregate net short 3.01% of Ericsson shares at position date 2026-10-13; the only disclosed holder above 0.5% is Two Sigma at 0.59% (trimmed from 0.68% on 2026-09-16), Citadel dropped below 0.5% on 2026-09-09 (https://www.fi.se/sv/vara-register/blankningsregistret/emittent?id=549300W9JLPW15XIFM52, list updated 2026-10-14 17:29). Options: 25-delta skew is null in the baseline; put/call open interest 0.31 (call-heavy), ATM IV 113.7% on a 2-day expiry with an 18.2% spread, so the 8.63% implied move is a loose number. Tape: -29.7% from the 52-week high, 20-day run-up -3.6%, 5-day +2.2%.

findings.finding: Ericsson built SEK 5bn of inventory in Q2 (SEK 25.7bn to 30.7bn) that the CFO said was 'mostly finished goods for planned Q3 deliveries', and the company guided Networks Q3 sales growth above the +1% three-year seasonality; consensus sits at +6% q/q (SEK 35.1bn against Q2's SEK 33.0bn, i.e. about SEK 2bn of extra sales, roughly SEK 1bn at cost), so the finished-goods build is several times the delivery volume the bar assumes, against a Q3 2025 comparison in which North America Networks sales declined (Americas organic -8%). Net of the rest: CSS (consensus SEK 15.2bn, guided at the +3% seasonal average) and Enterprise (4.7bn) would have to print at seasonality for the group sales line to clear SEK 55.4bn; neither carries a guide that argues otherwise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name pays on the sales line: Q2 2026 (2026-07-14) sales SEK 52.7bn against 53.6bn expected fell 8-12.6% in Stockholm (https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/ericsson-posts-softer-q2-sales,-shares-fall); Q4 2025 (2026-01-23) sales 69.3bn against 66.6bn rose about 11% (https://rte.ie/news/business/2026/0123/1554657-ericsson-quarterly-results/); Q3 2025 (2025-10-14) sales in line but gross profit beat rose 10%+ (https://www.aktiespararna.se/nyheter/ericsson-minskar-omsattning-men-okar-rorelseresultat).
findings.why_not_priced: The guide ('above seasonality') is in the wire and consensus has moved from +1% to +6% q/q, so the direction is priced; the size of the build relative to that +6% is not: the sell-side preview (hurbra.se, 2026-10-12) frames the question as whether the deliveries lift cash flow rather than whether +6% is too low, Handelsbanken's 2026-10-05 note (adj EBITA SEK 8.1bn vs 7.9bn consensus) is the only estimate found above the bar, and the stock sits 30% off its high with the 20-day run-up negative, which is not what a name positioned for a Networks beat looks like.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken (Nyhetsbyrån Direkt, 2026-10-05): 'relatively easy comparisons' in Q3 because of weak North American performance in Q3 2025, adj EBITA SEK 8.1bn, target raised to SEK 129 (https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-shb-ser-latta-jamforelsetal-3-kv-upprepar-koprad-20261005). The Q3 2025 report confirms the comp: Americas organic -8%, 'North America Networks sales declined' (https://www.ericsson.com/en/press-releases/2025/10/ericsson-reports-third-quarter-results-2025). The inventory figure itself is one document (the Q2 call) and is shared with no other finding.

findings.finding: The unpriced margin risk is the Q4 guide, not the Q3 print: the CFO said on the Q2 call that the component-cost impact 'should build gradually, with mitigation partly offsetting it in Q3 and more pressure expected coming out of the year and into 2027', contracts have no automatic pass-through, redesigns take six to nine months, and the company guides one quarter at a time, so the Q3 report will carry the first Q4 Networks gross-margin guide under that cost curve against a Q4 2025 Networks adj GM of 49.6% and a Q3 2026 guide of 48-50% (down from 50.4% in Q2). Consensus already carries the Q3 step-down (group adj GM 47.3% vs 48.4% in Q2), so the Q3 margin itself is inside what the company guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time the next-quarter margin guide disappointed (Q2 2026, 2026-07-14: 'cautious view on Q3 Networks margin' plus the cost-inflation warning) the stock fell about 8% in Stockholm and on Nasdaq pre-market (https://www.rttnews.com/3666700/ericsson-stock-drops-on-weak-q2-cautious-view-on-q3-networks-margin.aspx?type=corp); when the margin beat (Q3 2025, adj GM 48.1% vs a weaker expectation) it rose 10%+.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 48-50% guide is in every preview and in the 47.3% consensus; what is not is the Q4 number the company has not yet given. If the market had priced a Q4 margin step-down, the sell-side would carry FY26 gross-margin cuts (the Infront FY26 average is 47.7%, i.e. a Q4 at or above Q3) and Danske would not be the only note placing the pressure 'from Q4'. Memory contract prices reportedly rose about 20% in Q3 (Samsung, per Yicai/ZDNet via https://mezha.ua/en/news/samsung-pidvishchuye-cini-na-dram-na-20-312939/), a proxy for the input the CFO named (semiconductors) and not a company number.
findings.independence: Danske Bank (2026-10-05, via the same Direkt telegram as Handelsbanken): 'expects rising component costs to pressure margins from Q4, though Ericsson should be able to pass on much of this', Q3 adj EBITA cut 1% (https://www.placera.se/telegram/ericsson-shb-ser-latta-jamforelsetal-3-kv-upprepar-koprad-20261005). Nokia's Q2 (2026-07-23) guided its Mobile Infrastructure Q3 gross margin to 44-46% from 49.3% on software timing, and coverage ties memory prices to the segment without quantifying it (https://thenextweb.com/news/nokia-q2-2026-profit-ai-data-centre-demand). The memory-price series is a proxy. Shrunk once for the crowded ADR short (finding 3).

findings.finding: Short interest on the ADR line rose 16% in the last fortnight before settlement 2026-09-30 to 74.8M ADS with 10.2 days to cover (3.7 in mid-July), into a name that moved +10% or more on its last two Q3/Q4 prints, while the Stockholm register shows the opposite: aggregate 3.01% and the only disclosed holder (Two Sigma, 0.59%) trimming; the option book is call-heavy (put/call OI 0.31). A beat against a 10-day ADR cover is a squeeze mechanism in the ADR window; a miss has little fresh short to add.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-10-14) and Q4 2025 (2026-01-23) beats rose 10-18% and about 11% in Stockholm (https://www.placera.se/nyheter/ericsson-lyfter-borsen--upp-18-efter-rapport-2025-10-14, https://rte.ie/news/business/2026/0123/1554657-ericsson-quarterly-results/); the ADR's short cover at those dates is not sourced.
findings.why_not_priced: The build is ADR-specific and recent (the Stockholm register did not move with it), the baseline carries no short-interest field and a null skew, and a name whose downside were priced by shorts would show put-heavy open interest rather than 0.31; 10 days of cover on 8.3M ADS a day is not visible in the tape's -3.6% 20-day run-up.
findings.independence: Finansinspektionen aggregate 3.01% at 2026-10-13 with Two Sigma trimming 0.68% to 0.59% (https://www.fi.se/sv/vara-register/blankningsregistret/emittent?id=549300W9JLPW15XIFM52) points the other way for the Stockholm line, which is why the size is small and the range crosses zero.

findings.finding: IPR licensing: the Transsion settlement (2026-07-08, financial benefit 'beginning in Q3 2026') and a Verifone agreement lifted the annualised recurring run-rate to about SEK 13.5bn from about SEK 13bn at end-Q3 2025, so Q3 IPR should print around SEK 3.4bn against SEK 3.1bn in Q3 2025 (a y/y tailwind of about SEK 0.3bn at near-100% margin, roughly 4% of consensus adj EBITA), and the then-CEO said any Transsion catch-up in Q3 would be 'marginal' and was not assumed in guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: IPR one-offs have moved this name: Q2 2025 carried a Lenovo partial settlement that made the Q2 2026 IPR comparison (3.4bn vs 4.9bn) the stated cause of the -4% Networks organic decline that was sold -8% on 2026-07-14 (https://www.webull.com/news/15228507326080000).
findings.why_not_priced: The run-rate is on the company's own data-points page since 2026-09-11, so it is mostly priced; what the page does not say is whether a catch-up for Transsion's unlicensed period lands in Q3 (the Q3 2024 quarter carried retroactive revenue of that kind), and no preview found models one. If it does, it is a reported-quarter beat the bar does not hold; if not, the finding is the run-rate and worth close to zero.
findings.independence: IAM (2026-07-14): Transsion and Verifone deals set the licensing run-rate at SEK 13.5bn and all top-10 smartphone makers are now licensed (https://www.iam-media.com/article/ericsson-sets-new-patent-licensing-run-rate-following-transsion-verifone-deals). Company data-points page carries the same 13.5bn (https://www.ericsson.com/en/investors/financial-reports-and-presentations/current-quarter-data-points).

findings.finding: The Q3 2025 comparison carries a SEK 7.6bn one-off gain from the iconectiv divestment (adj EBITA 15.8bn, about 8.2bn ex-gain), so headline y/y EBITA and EPS will show a steep decline that the ADR-side previews already describe as 'a steep year-over-year decline in earnings per share'; the consensus adj EBITA of 7.9bn is set against the ex-gain base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The gain itself was looked through at the time: the Q3 2025 reaction was attributed to gross margin and EBITA ex-gain, not to the gain (https://www.aktiespararna.se/nyheter/ericsson-minskar-omsattning-men-okar-rorelseresultat).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced; filed so the judges see that an optically bad y/y headline on the wire is not new information. Sized at zero.
findings.independence: Wealthawesome preview (2026-10-14) frames the quarter as a steep y/y EPS decline (https://wealthawesome.com/telefonaktiebolaget-lm-ericsson-q3-2026-earnings-preview-10142026-event); the Q2 call confirmed Enterprise's reported -19% was 'mainly the iconectiv divestment' (https://www.webull.com/news/15228507326080000).

findings.finding: Danske Bank (2026-10-05) is more cautious on H2 because 'US operators are delaying some investments to 2027' and higher energy prices are hurting emerging-market operators, and cut its Q3 adj EBITA 1%; the broader series does not contradict it but does not confirm it either: Dell'Oro's Q2 2026 RAN report (2026-08-18) shows a third straight quarter of modest worldwide growth with 2026 still 'broadly flat', an uneven recovery, and Ericsson 'below expectations' in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A demand-tone downgrade on the Q2 2026 call ('flattish' RAN market, North America declined) sat beside the sales miss in the -8% reaction (https://www.webull.com/news/15228507326080000); not separable from the miss.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a sell-side claim about counterparties, not a company or operator statement; the operators' own Q3 calls (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) land after this print, so nothing in the public record has confirmed or refuted the delay. If it were priced, Handelsbanken would not be raising estimates on the same day. Filed small as a proxy; the search budget ran out before operator conference transcripts from September could be read.
findings.independence: Dell'Oro Q2 2026 RAN release (https://www.delloro.com/news/ran-market-growth-continues-in-2q-2026/, 2026-08-18) and Light Reading's read of it, Ericsson below expectations in Q2 (https://lightreading.com/open-ran/ran-market-growth-continues-in-2q-2026-dell-oro). The company's own data-points page quotes Dell'Oro as 'a more balanced phase'. Shrunk once for the crowded ADR short (finding 3).

findings.finding: This is Per Narvinger's first report as CEO (effective 2026-10-01, Ekholm stays as adviser to 2027-06-15); Handelsbanken wrote on 2026-10-05 that the balance sheet (net cash SEK 59.8bn at end-Q2) 'makes a restructuring of the Enterprise business more likely', the Q2 call said Vonage 'has not been contributing' with a turnaround plan and no timeline, and Enterprise ran at SEK -0.8bn adj EBITA in Q2; a first-report reset of Enterprise (charge, carve-out or sale process) is possible and undated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Vonage impairments (USD 2.9bn in 2023, 1.09bn later) were taken in quarters that sold off; the iconectiv and Aduna disposals in Q3 2025 were part of a quarter that rose 10%+. No clean read on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing dated in Q3 points to an action (the newsroom from 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-12 carries only buyback notices, a Japan R&D collaboration and the Q3 invitation), so the market cannot have priced a specific item; the sign is negative only because a new CEO's first-report reset is more often a charge than a gain, and the range runs to +1.0 for a disposal the market would welcome. Inference, not a document.
findings.independence: Light Reading on the appointment framed Narvinger as continuity, 'same(ish) as the old boss' (https://www.lightreading.com/5g/meet-ericsson-s-new-boss-same-ish-as-the-old-boss), which argues against a reset; Light Reading 2026-08-03 on Vonage's cumulative USD 450m operating loss and its disappearance as a reporting line (https://www.lightreading.com/5g/ericsson-kicks-off-vonage-revival-plan-after-years-of-losses). Sized at the caveat.

outside_window.finding: Nokia's Q3 2026 report (tentatively 2026-10-22) and the US operators' Q3 calls (late October) are the first counterparty reads on H2 RAN demand and component-cost pass-through; they land after the exit window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Ericsson newsroom 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-12: no contract win, IPR deal, restructuring, divestment or executive change; only weekly buyback notices, a Murata/Sumitomo 6G collaboration, Japan scenarios and the Q3 invitation (https://www.ericsson.com/en/newsroom/latest-news)

No sell-side preview from Barclays, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, SEB, Carnegie or a Reuters/Direkt poll dated October 2026 beyond the Handelsbanken/Danske telegram of 2026-10-05 and the hurbra.se Infront compilation of 2026-10-08
No ERIC analyst rating change dated October 2026 on MarketBeat/Benzinga/TipRanks results
Cause of the ADR's +3.63% on 2026-10-13: no Ericsson-specific news found (Swedish and English searches); not resolved
Vonage/Enterprise sale talks in 2026: nothing from Bloomberg or Reuters surfaced

Operator capex commentary from September conferences (Communacopia) and Airtel/Jio Q1 FY27 capex: the per-turn search budget ran out before these could be read; only Vodafone Idea's FY27-29 INR 45,000 crore plan with about INR 9,000 crore of orders to Ericsson/Nokia/Samsung was found (https://www.sahi.com/news/vodafone-idea-plans-45-000-crore-network-investments-by-fy29-amid-better-financial-clarity-3338-PE1_COR)
Nasdaq's short-interest page returned HTTP 503; the Ericsson India analyst-briefing URL returned 404

rejected_candidates.candidate: Weekly share buybacks (SEK 15bn programme approved at the 2026 AGM, running to 2027; treasury stock 105.7M B shares at 2026-09-04) continue through the window
rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the price since the 2026-01-23 announcement and the 2026-04-17 start; the Q3 report carries no distribution decision (that is the Q4 report, per the company). No incremental information.

rejected_candidates.candidate: FX: USD/SEK averaged 9.61 in Q3 against the company's 9.7 assumption, EUR/SEK 11.07 vs 11.0; company estimates about 0% y/y and +2% q/q sales impact; Handelsbanken raised estimates 1-2% on the weaker krona
rejected_candidates.detail: Folded into finding 1 (the Networks sales line); the company's own page puts the net effect at about zero y/y, so it does not move the bar on its own.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Vodafone Idea placed about INR 9,000 crore of 4G/5G equipment orders with Ericsson, Nokia and Samsung under its FY27-29 INR 45,000 crore plan (Q1 FY27 call)
rejected_candidates.detail: Supports the 'planned Q3 deliveries' in finding 1 (India grew in Q2 on delivery timing) but is a three-vendor order with no Ericsson share or Q3 timing stated; counted inside finding 1's range rather than as a second finding on the same line.

baseline_tension: The tape (30% off the high, 20-day run-up negative, ADR short up 16%) is positioned for disappointment and the skew is null, so the one company-level positive (the finished-goods build for Q3 deliveries) cuts against the run-up while the margin-guide negative runs with it; the net lean is small and positive, carried in p_up 55 rather than in the size.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (positioning is the thing to beat): the two negative findings were shrunk once each for the crowded ADR short (10.2 days to cover, +16% in a fortnight): margin guide -1.5 to -1.2, Danske/Dell'Oro demand proxy -0.5 to -0.4; p_up left at 55

Lesson 6 (inside the guided range): the Q3 gross-margin step-down is inside the company's 48-50% guide and inside the 47.3% consensus, so finding 2 was relabelled from reported_quarter to guidance and its text now sizes only the Q4 guide the company has not given
Lesson 9 (net of the rest): finding 1 now states what CSS and Enterprise have to do for the group line to clear the bar; size unchanged

Lesson on untrustworthy reaction history: base rate rebuilt from the four confirmed prints (Q3 2025 +10 to +18, Q4 2025 +11, Q1 2026 +1 to +2.5, Q2 2026 -8 to -12.6 in Stockholm); abs_move_pct 8.0 unchanged, which the draft already used
Lessons 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8: read and applied with no change in size; the one-off (iconectiv comp) was already at 0, the proxies were already small, and no finding argues against itself
